data.statement: A damaged, blast-fueled Steam Generator continues updating as a BuildPayload on a Payload Conveyor; once its health reaches zero, the conveyor retains it for pickup and it can be placed at 0 HP.
data.prediction: After configuring Blast Compound, damaging the healthy generator, loading it on the prepared conveyor, and waiting, the conveyor will still visually contain a Steam Generator payload and the retrieved/placed block will show an empty health bar.
data.observation: UI testing confirmed the supplied Steam Generator could be fed Water and Blast Compound (displaying 132.0 power output) and it then showed nonfatal ground damage. data.summary: The prepared save was imported through Load Game and tested in gameplay. The Steam Generator was visibly supplied with Water and Blast Compound, showed 132.0 power output, and later showed nonfatal health loss while fueled. I controlled the supplied Mega and attempted pickup/transport, but did not obtain a confirmed Steam Generator payload on the conveyor, a visible post-explosion retrievable payload, or a placed empty/0-HP generator. The reported anomalous state was therefore not established.
